skills.name: ask-question
skills.description: Answers questions using only repository READMEs and configured documentation folders. Prefers the filesystem MCP server when available. Use when the user asks about project processes, local setup, assumptions, or existing documentation.

skills.name: decision-record
skills.description: Helps create and update project decision records in the configured decisions directory. Use when the user needs to record a project decision, options considered, or the chosen solution.

skills.name: memory-settings
skills.description: Checks for and creates the shared project memory configuration at .memory/settings.yml. Use when another skill needs this file, or when the user asks to set up memory settings.
